contentMD5.description: md5 of the content referred by 'content'

contentSHA1.description: sha1 of the content referred by 'content'

offset.description: Offset in bytes from the start of the content

length.description: length of the content in bytes after the offset

startIndex.description: Index of the obj at the offset.

count.description: Number of objs in the content from offset to length.

csvHeader.description: csvHeader to use for deserialization; required if the contentType is text/csv.

title: Represents a part of content which can deserialize into C3 objs
